main.description: Serve a blob referenced by a permissioned space, to a viewer the space admits. These cannot go through the CDN: the space serves a blob only to a credential holder, and a CDN is an unauthenticated cache keyed by a public URL.

space.description: Space URI the blob is referenced from.

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.description: The viewer is not a member of this space.
